recommendation: CONTROLLED_SHADOW_EVALUATION — The retrieval system demonstrates strong equipment identification accuracy (100% product-correct on 40-case red team) and solid security controls (zero cross-tenant leakage, proper auth enforcement). However, the system cannot be cleared for production release due to: (1) untested answer generation quality, (2) no independent evaluation, (3) no real data authorization, (4) manifest metadata errors. A controlled shadow evaluation with human review is appropriate after fixing the serving config and manifest.
